City of Encinitas
Environmental Commission Meeting
AGENDA
MARCH 13, 2025 -
05:30 PM
City of Encinitas - Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Ave
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.
1.
CALL TO ORDER/ROLL CALL
2.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
3.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announce administrative changes to the agenda in compliance with the Brown Act.
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Oral comments (maximum of 3 minutes) will be heard from people who submit a WHITE speaker’s slip to the commission secretary. No discussion or action may be taken by the Commission on such non-agenda items. If needed, Oral Communications / Public Comment items will be referred to City Staff either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
5.
PRESENTATION:
A.
Commercial Surplus Food: Data & Extraordinary Successes – Skylar Enge, UCSD Scripps Researcher, Larissa Amaral, Solana Center Associate Manager, and Jessica Toth, Executive Director
6.
APPROVAL OF MINUTES
A.
Approval of February 13, 2025 Meeting Minutes
Item 6A_Draft Meeting Minutes 02-13-2025
7.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
A.
None.
8.
ACTION ITEMS
A.
Draft updated Climate Action Plan. Crystal Najera, Sustainability Manager and Ryan Lamkin, Sustainability Analyst
1.
Review the draft Climate Action Plan
2.
Provide input on the draft Climate Action Plan
Item 8A Agenda Report - Draft Update Climate Action Plan
Item 8A Attachment 1 - Draft CAP
B.
March update of progress on the Fiscal Year 2024-25 to 2025-26 Work Plan and review of Commission Calendar. Crystal Najera, Sustainability Manager
1.
Review and Approve March 2025 Work Plan Update.
2.
Review Commission Calendar.
Item 8B Agenda Report Work Plan Update
Item 8B Attachment 1 - Work Plan Update March 2025
Item 8B Attachment 2 - Commission Calendar
C.
Annual Selection of Chair and Vice Chair for One Year Term. Crystal Najera, Sustainability Manager
1.
Select a Chairperson and Vice Chairperson for a one-year term.
Item 8C Agenda Report - Annual Selection of Chair and Vice Chair
Item 8C Attachment 1 - EMC 2.49
9.
COMMISSIONER INITIATED ACTION AGENDA ITEMS
A.
Food Service Survey Results. Commission Chair Cramer and Commission Vice Chair O’Connor.
1.
Review feedback from local food providers on transition of single-use plastic food ware to reusable and compostable food ware and consider making any changes to the recommended amendments to Encinitas Municipal Code 11.27.
Item 9A Agenda Report - Foodware Amendment Business Outreach Results
10.
UPDATES ON ITEMS OF INTEREST TO COMMISSION/ANNOUNCEMENTS BY COMMISSION MEMBERS/STAFF
11.
FUTURE COMMISSIONER INITIATED AGENDA ITEMS Discussion of possible future commissioner-initiated agenda items, including informational items, presentations, or action items, if any.
12.
ADJOURNMENT - The next Environmental Commission meeting is scheduled for April 10, 2025.
